description: Receive and verify Cronofy push notifications (webhooks). Use when setting up Cronofy notification channels, debugging Cronofy-HMAC-SHA256 verification, or handling Cronofy calendar events like verification, change, profile_disconnected, conferencing_profile_disconnected, profile_initial_sync_completed, and gdpr_requested. Cronofy signs the raw body with your application's client secret and sends a COMMA-SEPARATED list of base64 HMACs in the Cronofy-HMAC-SHA256 header.
